Terracotta band and condensed slab display type suit the trade. The door-sheet 'before/after' table and the closing CTA band are familiar patterns.
evidence.proof: The operable kiln is in the first viewport at 1440 (card top 124px) and starts at y=418 at 390. Numbers are consistent across the page: the hero says '7 of 12 spots claimed', which becomes 8 after a claim, and 'tell the 7 members' becomes 'you and the 7 other members'. evidence.craft: axe-core (probe.json plus my own wcag2a/aa/best-practice run at 1440 and 390): 0 violations. Token-based CSS (colour, spacing scale --s-*, radius, font stacks), focus styles adjusted for the dark and clay grounds (white outline with a clay halo on the kiln controls). Defects: the mobile menu is positioned top:76px but the header ends at 63px at 390, so a strip of the h1 shows between header and open menu. Duplicate rule blocks (.top, .reset). Unreachable build() fallback, since the shelves are already in the HTML. aria-labelledby on a plain div (.kiln-card) has no effect without a role. The display font stack leads with 'DejaVu Serif' and uses font-stretch:condensed with no condensed face, so rendering will differ across platforms. og:image is the relative 'og.png' (crawlers need an absolute URL). Weight: 35KB HTML plus a 108KB og.png that only crawlers fetch, and no web fonts. Zoom 200%: 0 overflow, no overlaps.
evidence.mobile: 390 is recomposed: the CTA goes full width, the 'in use' line is hidden, and the kiln card tightens padding. The kiln stage buttons are visible at y~490 in the first screen. Overflow is 0 at 390 and 320. At <=760px the firing-log table reflows into stacked rows, with labels supplied in CSS ('Spots: '). Menu button 44px; opens a 249px panel, Tab moves into it, Escape closes it and returns focus to 'Menu', tapping 'Firing log' closes it and scrolls to #log (top at 80px), and tabbing past the last link closes it. Spots 52px high, stage buttons 44px. Footer links are 32px high.
evidence.honesty: 'Sample kiln, written for this page', 'Sample sheet and chat, written for this page' and 'Sample week, written for this page' are each placed above their artifact, visible at 390. 'In use at three community studios since spring' is a brief fact, and no figures are claimed. The CTA note states what the trial is and who it is for before the click. The 'message sent' state is inside the labelled sample.
evidence.interaction: Operated at 1440/768/390 by mouse/touch and keyboard. Claim shelf 1 spot 2 gives 'You claimed shelf 1, spot 2. 8 of 12 spots claimed.' and the message preview updates. Claiming another spot gives 'You moved to shelf 3, spot 3... In this sample you hold one spot.' Clicking the same spot gives it back (back to 7 of 12). Firing/Cooling/Out recolour the chamber, open spots read 'Empty', and Out switches the message to 'Kilnlog · message sent... Your piece is on shelf 2, spot 2.' Claiming during Out shows an error state: 'Shelf spots can only be claimed while the kiln is loading. Press Loading to try it.' Reset restores loading and 7 of 12. Enter claims, Space releases, and focus stays on the spot. 10 rapid clicks left a consistent state. Status appears above the shelves and stayed in view after tapping a bottom spot at 390. No console errors. Small flaw: during non-loading stages the spot buttons still announce 'open. Press to claim it' while the visible text is 'Empty'.
evidence.copy: Concrete and in the studio's voice: 'Squeeze your name into a gap on the sheet and hope nobody writes over it', 'the group chat goes back to talking about pots', sheet entries like 'who took my spot??'. Microcopy is written, not defaulted ('In this sample you hold one spot.', 'Press Loading to try it.'). Some repetition: the CTA note is identical in hero and final band, and the 3-row before/after table restates the lead.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: specific outcome plus a named audience in the lead, the CTA 'Start your free 30-day trial' with its owner/member note, and the operable labelled sample kiln, all in one viewport. 390: the promise, a full-width CTA, the note, and the kiln card's title, stage buttons, status and message preview are in view; the shelves start just at the fold.

problems: The owners' path is a single paragraph: nothing shows how an owner sets the schedule, firings or shelf rules, the trust question the brief raises.
Mobile menu offset (top:76px versus a 63px header at 390) leaves a sliver of the h1 visible between the header and the open menu.

Code hygiene: unreachable build() fallback, duplicate .top/.reset rules, aria-labelledby on a role-less div, stale 'open. Press to claim it' aria-labels in non-loading stages, relative og:image, DejaVu-first display font stack.

reason: B passes axe with zero violations where A has 8 serious contrast failures. B's one artifact sits in the first screen at both widths, with consistent numbers, a reset and an error state; its mobile menu and table reflow hold up under keyboard and touch. A keeps its claim demo 1600-3300px down, contradicts itself on open spots, and needs sideways scrolling for its log on phones. A much fuller owners section in B, or A fixing the contrast and moving the claim demo up, would narrow the gap.
